title: Entity verification verdict
responsibility: Judges an entity using the newest valid record of its exact revision and its applicable coverage.

inputs.name: verdictRecord.detail
inputs.description: Revision whose records should be selected.

inputs.name: verdictCoverage.unit
inputs.description: Unit identifier whose scenarios should be judged.

inputs.name: verdictCoverage.detail
inputs.description: Revision providing registry and verification records.

inputs.name: explorerVerdict.unit
inputs.description: Unit whose overall proof is requested.

inputs.name: explorerVerdict.detail
inputs.description: Revision supplying records, coverage and budget findings.

outputs.name: verdictRecord
outputs.description: Newest valid record whose source commit exactly matches the revision, ordered by finishedAt text, or null.

outputs.name: verdictCoverage
outputs.description: Coverage of scenarios naming the unit, narrowed state by state. No registry yields an empty list; absent usable records leave required states without proof.

outputs.name: explorerVerdict
outputs.description: Passed only when applicable checks leave no blocking reason: required gates exist, global gates and tests pass, scenarios establish applicable coverage, and the unit has no open failures or budget findings. Labels distinguish unusable, failed, stale, missing and incomplete evidence; reasons are deduplicated and stripped of matching file-location wording.
